patch_description: Structural redesign as a staged hybrid optimizer: alternating (a) Powell smooth-softmin stages over the full 33-dim logit parametrization (global, keeps feasibility) and (b) discrete worst-triplet refinement that finds the argmin triplet, optimizes only that triplet's points with a softmin objective, and geometrically pushes each of the three points perpendicular to the opposite edge. A best-config registry tracks the true (non-smooth) min-area across all stages, and results from Powell runs feed directly into triplet polishing, importing the runner-up's incremental triple-aware efficiency. Time-budgeted (~8s), deterministic seeds, hardcoded fallback for safety.
